newsitem.title: MACAU: Gunman shoots two Macau undercover detectives.
newsitem.headline: Gunman shoots two Macau undercover detectives.

text.p: A gunman shot two undercover Macau detectives early on Monday, seriously injuring one, in the latest outbreak of violent crime in the Portuguese-administered territory due to revert to Chinese rule in 1999.
One of the detectives was still in serious condition late on Monday, while the other was said by police to be "recovering well".
The gunman, riding pillion, fired a total of three shots at the duo after they stopped their car at a traffic junction during an undercover patrol, police sources told Reuters.
The shooting comes after Lieutenant-Colonel Manuel Antonio Apolinario, a senior Macau casino police official, was shot twice in the face and neck in November 1996.
